artifacts.summary: 10-phase implementation plan for the docstring and citation normalisation sweep across FormalSystem/, BimodalTools/ and Tests/.

summary: Ten-phase plan, ~15h, waves [1,2] then strictly serial 3-10. Ordered bib-merge-first (58 typst-only keys must exist in references.bib before prose citations can be converted) and re-anchor-tool-second (scripts/reanchor-lean-citations.py is a Phase 2 deliverable written before the first docstring edit, not a fix-up). Phases 3-9 are organised by disjoint FILE SET rather than by edit type, so each file is touched once and the C20 re-anchor runs once at the end of each phase rather than interleaved; they are serialized anyway because each repair pass rewrites citer files tree-wide. Acceptance replaced with a 12-row table measured red at HEAD b668923b1 (0 entries in target citation form vs 197 in the old bare form, 119 markdown-link cross-refs, 14 personal paths, 17 literature/ pointers, 27 Logos/ProofChecker, 12 Paper Specification Reference, 4 Implementation Status, 2 dangling bibkeys, 26 bib entries -> 84), since the task's original grep -rn 'home/benjamin' is already vacuously green. Gating is on the build-inclusive check-module-invariants.sh, never lake build, run foreground with timeout 600000. Historical-record preservation is called out per-file for Semantics/TaskFrame.lean and Metalogic/Soundness.lean; sub: anchors stay verbatim; the L+ label citations are gold standard, not conversion targets; Boneyard/ is out of scope. The unresolved-bibkey user decision is carried forward non-blocking with a re-point default isolated in its own Phase 1 checklist item.
